title: ROOM 17
eyebrow: CASE ZERO / AN ORIGINAL PRACTICE CASE
tagline: The room has answers. The hallway has eyes.
briefing: An anonymous caller left you a motel key and a simple job: recover the black ledger from the locked case, then get out without being seen. The room is quiet. It won’t stay that way.

clues.label: Brass key
clues.note: The tag reads ROOM 17. A smaller tooth on the key fits the slot beside the case’s number lock. Keep it.

clues.label: Desk clock
clues.note: Under the clock, a service note reads: NIGHT DEPOSIT — 09:40. A second line says: HOURS, THEN MINUTES. FOUR DIGITS. The hands aren’t the clue. The note is.

clues.label: Evacuation map
clues.note: A penciled route connects Room 17 to the rear service stairs. The lobby is covered by a camera. The brass key opens the service door. Quiet is better than fast.

clues.label: Ringing phone
clues.note: You pick up. A voice says, ‘The lobby is clear.’ Then the line clicks twice. Someone now knows the room is occupied. The map tells a different story.

clues.label: Curtain cord
clues.note: You pull the cord free. It will hold long enough to reach the fire escape through the window. The blinds snap against the wall. That was loud.

exits.label: Service stairs
exits.description: Follow the penciled route. Requires the evacuation map.

exits.label: Front lobby
exits.description: The shortest walk. The camera will get a clear look at you.

exits.label: Fire escape
exits.description: Go through the window. Requires the curtain cord.

ghost.title: You were never here.
ghost.description: Ledger recovered. Service door locked behind you. No camera frame, no noise trail. A clean exit.

shadow.title: Out of the room. Not out of sight.
shadow.description: You recovered the ledger, but your route left a trace. A cleaner run is possible. Review what raised the room alert.

exposed.title: You got the ledger. They got your face.
exposed.description: The lobby camera caught you leaving. The job is complete, but the next move will be harder.

lockdown.title: The hallway goes silent.
lockdown.description: Too many moves, too much noise, or too many wrong combinations. The case is sealed and the exit is gone. Start again. Read the room.
